sourceFile: 31.1 TIU C11-20  Report Test new press Jig ( Frame+ VP) 2026.1.5. - RAW soundcheck_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable rows but the primary changed factor and several comparisons are misgrouped.
issues: Primary change is new VP press jig vs Normal, not Day/Night/TOTAL.
Date, shift, model, and TOTAL are subgroup or aggregation keys, not changed conditions.
Several pairs use mismatched Normal baselines instead of adjacent subgroup rows or totals.
Function totals and row-level results are mixed inconsistently.
RAW DATA SPL/UV measurements are not clearly tied to the press-jig comparison.
requiredUserQuestions: Are RAW DATA soundcheck UV/SPL results part of this new VP press-jig validation?
correctionPlan: Rename changed factor to Normal vs Test use new VP press Jig.
Move date, shift, model, and process variant into subgroupKeys.
Rebuild Frame+VP, VP separate, and function pairs using matched adjacent rows and separate totals.
Remove or separate RAW DATA measurement outcomes unless linked by source context.
Replace graph-derived title with the Test sheet report title and purpose.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Test-sheet row citations are sufficient; RAW DATA citations need clearer changed-condition linkage.
